about: What the owl says for what the screen shows, in lessons (tools/lessons/speech/README.md). rules: a pattern (Python regex) and what she says instead, applied in order; status pending until the owner hears it and signs it off for this voice (voice: the id it was signed for). cases: words heard otherwise that the owner heard and found right as written.

rules.why: a stressed vowel with a diaeresis (Ταΰγετος) comes out garbled; «ή» sounds the same
a height in metres: the owl skipped «μ.»
degrees Celsius: «οC» was read as a letter
a parenthesis inside a sentence: said between two pauses, without the brackets
a parenthesis at the end of a phrase: said after a pause, without the brackets
